articles.title: Joy of Giving: A’bad man nears 300-blood donation milestone and 80,000-unit ripple effect
articles.description: Ahmedabad’s Harish Patel, 58, set to donate blood for the 300th time, inspiring 1,994 camps and 80,000 units via Satya Sai Group, says Red Cross.

articles.title: Ripple Exec: XRP's 'Killer Use Case' Lies in Institutional Collateral
articles.description: RippleX head of product highlights XRP’s potential in institutional credit.

articles.title: Clearpool's Clear Token Migration Fuels XRP Ledger Growth
articles.description: Clearpool is migrating its CPOOL token to CLEAR and expanding institutional lending infrastructure onto the XRP Ledger, supported by Ripple investment and RLUSD settlement.

articles.title: Is Ripple Prime Bad for XRP Price?
articles.description: Ripple Prime has turned Ripple into a broader institutional financial-services provider, but its expansion beyond XRP does not mean the company has abandoned the token.

articles.title: Ripple just 2 weeks away from 10th 1 billion XRP dump of 2026
articles.description: Ripple is approaching its 10th scheduled XRP escrow unlock of 2026, with 1 billion XRP set to be released on October 1.

articles.title: Fiber optic installation planned in Statesville Country Club area
articles.description: Statesville approved a permit for Ripple Fiber to install underground fiber optic lines in the Statesville Country Club area from Sept. 14 to Oct. 9, 2026.

articles.title: Saudi Pipeline Attacked: Ripple Effects on Global Oil
articles.description: Saudi Arabia's vital East-West pipeline has been shut following a drone attack originating from Iraq amidst an escalating Middle East conflict. The attack strains global oil supplies, particularly as Iran-backed Houthis advance in Yemen's strategic Red Sea region. Saudi Arabia seeks U.S. aid to stabilize the situation.
